100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On October 1, 1926, a significant diplomatic tension arose as the League of Nations continued its efforts to mediate disputes in Europe, notably concerning the ongoing conflict between Greece and Bulgaria. In the United States, the stock market showed signs of volatility, raising concerns among investors about the economic stability ahead of the winter months. Meanwhile, in the realm of entertainment, the film industry buzzed with excitement over the upcoming release of silent films as talkies began to reshape Hollywood's landscape.
